name: io.github.Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes
description: MCP server for interacting with Kubernetes clusters via kubectl

environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG_YAML
environmentVariables.description: Kubeconfig supplied as a YAML string. Takes priority over KUBECONFIG_PATH.

environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG_JSON
environmentVariables.description: Kubeconfig supplied as a JSON string. Takes priority over KUBECONFIG_PATH.

environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the kubeconfig file. Defaults to ~/.kube/config.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_ONLY_NON_DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose only non-destructive tools (excludes kubectl_delete, exec_in_pod, node_management, and Helm uninstall).

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_ONLY_READONLY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose only read-only tools (get, describe, logs, explain, context listing).

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-delimited allowlist of specific tool names to expose. All other tools are hidden.

environmentVariables.name: MASK_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to disable automatic masking of Kubernetes Secret values in responses. Masking is enabled by default.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_KUBECTL_UNSAFE_FLAGS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to allow kubectl flags that redirect API connections (e.g. --server, --token, --kubeconfig). Disabled by default as a defence against prompt-injection attacks.

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_UNSAFE_STREAMABLE_HTTP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable the Streamable HTTP transport. Requires HOST and PORT. Pair with MCP_AUTH_TOKEN in production.

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_UNSAFE_SSE_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable the legacy SSE transport. Pair with MCP_AUTH_TOKEN in production.

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport. Defaults to 'localhost'. Set to '0.0.0.0' only in isolated/containerised environments.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for the HTTP transport. Defaults to 3000.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared-secret token for the HTTP transport. When set, every request must include the header 'X-MCP-AUTH: <token>'. Strongly recommended when HOST is not localhost.

environmentVariables.name: DNS_REBINDING_PROTECTION
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to disable DNS rebinding protection on the HTTP transport. Protection is enabled by default.

environmentVariables.name: DNS_REBINDING_ALLOWED_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Override the allowed Host header value checked by DNS rebinding protection. Useful when the server is accessed through a reverse proxy.

environmentVariables.name: SPAWN_MAX_BUFFER
environmentVariables.description: Maximum output buffer size in bytes for kubectl command execution. Defaults to 1048577 (1 MB + 1 byte).

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' or '1' to enable OpenTelemetry tracing. Also requires OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to be set.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: OTLP endpoint URL for exporting traces (e.g. http://localhost:4318). Required when ENABLE_TELEMETRY is set.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Service name reported in OpenTelemetry traces.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Service version reported in OpenTelemetry traces.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
environmentVariables.description: Additional key=value resource attributes attached to every OpenTelemetry span.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER
environmentVariables.description: OpenTelemetry trace sampler name (e.g. 'always_on', 'always_off', 'traceidratio').

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG
environmentVariables.description: Argument passed to the configured OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER (e.g. a sampling ratio like '0.1').

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_CAPTURE_RESPONSE_METADATA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' or '0' to exclude tool response metadata from OpenTelemetry spans. Captured by default.
